name: A Mage's Burden of Love
source:
[i]"‘I love you so much, I'd die for you.’ Is there any truth to that platitude, I wonder?"[/i]

These are the musings of Rosetta D'Amato, an aspiring young mage arriving at the tail end of a blood curse gifted to her by generations of transgression. 

Cursed to die before she reaches the age of 25, a 24 year old Rosetta has made no plans of celebrating her upcoming birthday. Instead, she's spent years researching every loophole and solution she could, all to arrive at one conclusion: 

The lethal curse will destroy the vessel it inhabits; Rosetta is more than willing to trade hers with a willing… or less than willing volunteer. 

After summoning the 5th great demon lord, patron of betrayal, bargains and opportunity, Zantedeschia, Rosetta is determined to free herself from her predetermined tragedy; by any means necessary.

[From [url=https://fivebirdsmakinggames.itch.io/a-mages-burden-of-love]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
[i]“‘我深爱着你，愿为你去死。’不知这句陈词滥调里，究竟有几分真话？”[/i]

这是年轻见习法师罗塞塔·达马托心中的低语——世代罪孽降下的血脉诅咒，已在她身上走到了尽头。

受诅活不过25岁的罗塞塔如今已经24岁，她丝毫没有庆祝即将到来的生日的打算。相反，多年来她穷尽心力钻研每一处契约漏洞与破解之法，最终得出了唯一的结论：

致命的诅咒将会摧毁它所寄宿的肉身容器；而罗塞塔十分乐意拿自己的躯壳，与某位自愿……或是不那么自愿的志愿者做一笔交换。

在召唤出司掌背叛、契约与机遇的第五大魔王赞特德斯基亚之后，罗塞塔下定决心要不择一切手段，将自己从注定的悲剧宿命中解救出来。

[摘自[url=https://fivebirdsmakinggames.itch.io/a-mages-burden-of-love]itch.io[/url]]
